description: Time-averages the spectrum over a window of analysis frames, smearing spectral content across time. Operates on PVOC analysis files (.ana).
musical_use: Softens transients, washes out spectral detail, produces hazy or fogged-out versions of the source. Good for turning percussive material into spectral pads, or for blending a sound with itself over time.

blurring.description: Number of analysis windows to average over. Larger values produce more smearing. May vary over time (breakpoint capability deferred to Phase 1b).

examples.expected_use: Soften the attack of a percussive spectral source while preserving overall pitch content.
